items.title: Trump, With Limited Options in Iran, Tries Economic Pressure — Again
items.summary: Iran has survived decades of sanctions. Faced with more, it is likely to escalate rather than surrender, analysts said.

items.title: Ukraine’s Ex-Defense Minister Calls for Election, Cementing Break With Zelensky
items.summary: Mykhailo Fedorov, a popular young leader who was fired last month, said Russia should not be allowed to dictate when Ukrainians can choose their next government.

items.title: Trump and Canada’s Carney Seem to Make Progress on a Tariff Deal, but Questions Linger

items.title: U.A.E. Announces Halt to Trade With Iran Amid Trump’s Push To Isolate Tehran

items.title: Israel Opens Criminal Investigation Into Killings of Hind Rajab and Gaza Medical Workers
items.summary: Two high-profile cases that had spurred international condemnation of the country’s conduct in Gaza were transferred to the military police. Such investigations have rarely led to convictions.

items.title: North Korean Official Dismisses Reduced Drills Between US and South Korea
items.summary: Kim Yo-jong, a powerful adviser and sister of Kim Jong-un, also said she was “unaware” of any communication with Washington, contradicting President Trump’s claim her brother had responded to his outreach.

items.title: Trump Pauses 50 Percent Tariffs on Canada and Claims Deal Is Near
items.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney of Canada was less definitive about what the intense talks produced, saying “important work” remained.

items.title: After Youth Outcry, Vietnam Says Former Official Caused Fatal Crash at Tree 55
items.summary: Young people are calling for justice after a former Communist Party official killed a teenager in a car crash. The government’s response has been surprising.

items.title: Erin Patterson, Woman Convicted in Australia’s Mushroom Murder Case, Appeals

items.title: Rebel Ice Cream Files for Bankruptcy After Van Leeuwen Wins Packaging Suit

items.title: Many Student Loan Borrowers May Have to Switch to Worse Repayment Plans
